author: blu
body: Typed observer pattern (inspired by Godot signals). Nodes emit named signals; connected receivers are invoked automatically. Connections are scoped to emitter lifetime -- when a node is removed, its connections are severed. No global event bus.

author: reek
body: Signals carry an integer payload (entity ID, value, etc.). The signal table is a flat list of connections indexed by signal name hash. Fixed capacity per entity.
